what_it_does: ORBIT-2 is a large AI model for improving weather and climate predictions at high resolution. Weather models operate at coarse resolution, limiting regional decision-making. The system scales to 10 billion parameters across 65,536 graphics processors. It combines two key innovations: an efficient Vision Transformer variant with residual learning to improve predictions, and an algorithm that reduces the computational complexity of self-attention from quadratic to linear, enabling processing of very long sequences.
